data.narrative:
Positron AI is a Series B semiconductor company founded by Thomas Sohmers, Barrett Woodside, and Edward Kmett, currently valued at $1.0B+ post-money following $230M+ in total fundraising. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 3 public semiconductor companies (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private competitors including SambaNova Systems, Etched, d-Matrix, and DEEPX.

Two applicable valuation methods were deployed. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $1.0B, implying $1.9B. Peer-median analysis across 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range from $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $11.0B (SambaNova Systems, Series A). Public comp anchoring using a 21.5x P/S multiple across the semiconductor sector cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for Positron AI.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.6B to $4.0B, with a median of $2.7B. The wide peer dispersion—particularly the $11.0B outlier in SambaNova at an earlier stage—signals material uncertainty around capital intensity, technical defensibility, and market timing within frontier semiconductor infrastructure. Revenue disclosure and product-market validation velocity represent the primary uncertainty drivers for near-term revaluation.
